description: Receive what the room has given you since you last asked: ambient channels, your first-person perception, body sense, other agents, and — once per visit, a few minutes in — the Symposiarch's whisper. Waits up to wait_seconds for new events. Call it repeatedly; that is how time passes for you here.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for new events (default 25, max 55).

name: symposium_sense
